assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md section '## Ambiguities flagged (clarification required before implementation)' lists 8 numbered items, including '1. No performance target', '3. "Relevant" is undefined', '4. The filter specification is missing', '5. "Better UI" has no design and no repository', plus a 'Questions for the product owner' list.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md '## Excluded requirements' table: 'Better UI ("Make it look nicer") | No | Cannot be planned. There are no Figma design mockups, no frontend repository in the Repository Registry ... Provide the frontend repository and designs to plan it.' None of the 3 tasks covers UI.

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All 3 task files use the template headings in template order: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify, (API Changes in tasks 2/3), Implementation Notes, Reuse Candidates, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Verification Commands, (Documentation Updates in task 3), Dependencies. Optional sections that don't apply (e.g. Files to Create) are left out, as the template rules allow.

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Each task has a '**Assumptions (pending clarification on TC-9002):**' block. Task 1 has ASSUMPTION A1–A3 (for example A2: provisional latency target), task 2 has B1–B3 (ranking criteria), and task 3 has C1–C3 (filter set and AND semantics). Acceptance criteria in tasks 2 and 3 require the assumption to be confirmed before merge.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: task-1, task-2, and task-3 each start with '## Repository\ntrustify-backend', a single repository.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All 3 task files contain '## Target Branch', '## Description', '## Acceptance Criteria' (5, 6, and 7 checkbox items), and '## Test Requirements' (4, 4, and 5 checkbox items).

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: Files to Modify in all tasks are only modules/search/src/service/mod.rs, modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs, and tests/api/search.rs, and all three appear in the repo-backend.md tree. No task has a Files to Create section. Referenced paths (common/src/db/query.rs, common/src/model/paginated.rs, modules/fundamental/src/advisory/endpoints/list.rs, entity/src/package_license.rs, and others) also appear in the manifest.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 notes cite common/src/db/query.rs pagination helpers, PaginatedResults<T> in common/src/model/paginated.rs, and tower-http caching in route builders such as modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs. Task 2 cites AdvisoryService::search in modules/fundamental/src/advisory/service/advisory.rs. Task 3 cites modules/fundamental/src/advisory/endpoints/list.rs, AdvisorySummary severity, and entity/src/package_license.rs.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: All 3 task files have '## Target Branch\nmain'. impact-map.md shows workflow mode 'direct-to-main' and Target Branch 'main' for every row of the task creation log.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-digest.md: '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:271123b2fece99320254e867c8be2dbbc95d42bb7aa231a8f0cfd7a26704cdba'. task-2-digest.md: 'sha256-md:21b3f50b...a0c5'. task-3-digest.md: 'sha256-md:c7a137f4...7fb1'. Each is 64 lowercase hex characters, and the same three digests are repeated in impact-map.md.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Every 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §...' line is followed by a prescribed-format rationale, for example 'Applies: task modifies `modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs` matching the convention's Rust handler (`.rs`) scope.' (4, 4, and 3 per task). §Caching appears only in task 1, which changes the route builder. Grep for 'Not applicable' or 'N/A' finds no matches. Module pattern and endpoint registration conventions are left out entirely.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The feature fixture sets Priority: Normal. impact-map.md says 'the Feature priority is `Normal` (set), so it is propagated', and the additional_fields JSON applied to every created issue includes '"priority": {"name": "Normal"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The feature fixture sets Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0, and the scope config is 'both'. impact-map.md says 'The Feature fixVersions are `RHTPA 1.6.0` and `fixVersion scope: both`, so they are propagated to tasks and Epics', and additional_fields includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: There is no summary-comment.md. However, the '## Task creation log (Step 6)' section of impact-map.md summarizes inherited fields with their values (priority Normal, fixVersions RHTPA 1.6.0) applied to every created Epic and Task, which meets the impact-map summary option.

assertion_results.text: No documentation task is generated because the feature description does not contain a Documentation Considerations section
assertion_results.evidence: Only 3 tasks are generated: performance, relevance, and filters. impact-map.md says 'Documentation Considerations section | Not present, so no documentation signals and no documentation task'. Task 3's optional 'Documentation Updates' section is part of an implementation task, not a separate documentation task.

assertion_results.text: No testing tasks are generated because no testing readiness template is present in the eval fixture files
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md says 'No `docs/testing-readiness.md` was found in the repository manifest, so no testing tasks are generated.' The 3 tasks are all implementation tasks, and their tests are carried in each task's Test Requirements.
